scoring_method: Observable structural signals from local clone analysis. Each dimension 0-100 based on file counts, feature presence, architecture patterns, and documented capabilities.

dimensions.name: Architecture & Extensibility
dimensions.hermes_signals: Monolith with module separation. Toolsets composable but no formal SDK boundary. registry.register() pattern. No import guards.
dimensions.openclaw_signals: Full plugin SDK with manifest, lifecycle, typed contracts. Strict import boundaries. AGENTS.md per boundary. Architecture doc coverage. 93 extensions prove extensibility.

dimensions.name: Agent Loop & Intelligence
dimensions.hermes_signals: Self-improving skill creation loop. 116 built-in skills (73 core + 43 optional). Memory nudges. Honcho user modeling. Batch runner + RL training + 11 model parsers. Smart model routing. Mixture of Agents tool. Trajectory compression. 90-iteration budget.
dimensions.openclaw_signals: Solid agent loop with thinking support. Model failover. 53 bundled skills. ClawHub marketplace. No self-improvement loop. No research infrastructure. No batch processing.

dimensions.name: Messaging & Channels
dimensions.hermes_signals: 16 platforms built-in. Gateway hardening (v0.7.0). Unique: Email, SMS, DingTalk, Home Assistant, WeCom. API Server for Open WebUI.
dimensions.openclaw_signals: 23+ channel plugins. Unique: iMessage, LINE, Twitch, Nostr, Google Chat, MS Teams, Nextcloud, QQ, Voice Call, Zalo. Plugin model enables community channels.

dimensions.name: Tools & Capabilities
dimensions.hermes_signals: 49 tool files. Anti-detection browser (Camofox). 6 terminal backends (SSH, Modal, Daytona, Singularity). Home automation. RL training tool. Image gen + TTS/STT built-in.
dimensions.openclaw_signals: 24 tool plugins + core tools. Video generation. Phone control. LanceDB vector memory. OpenCode integration. Broader media pipeline (fal, deepgram, elevenlabs).

dimensions.name: Memory & Learning
dimensions.hermes_signals: Pluggable provider ABC. Self-nudging memory. Honcho dialectic user modeling. FTS5 cross-session search. Skills as procedural memory. Memory flush state persistence.
dimensions.openclaw_signals: Memory plugin slot. memory-core + LanceDB. No self-nudging. No dialectic user modeling. Standard memory persistence.

dimensions.name: Security & Safety
dimensions.hermes_signals: Secret exfiltration blocking (URL+base64+prompt injection). Credential directory protection. Command approval with sudo callbacks. Website policy. Tirith security.
dimensions.openclaw_signals: Command gating + allowlists. CODEOWNERS security rules. GHSA advisory workflow. Device pairing. Sandbox Dockerfiles. Prompt cache stability = security consideration. Formal security governance.

dimensions.name: Developer Experience
dimensions.hermes_signals: curl installer. Setup wizard. Doctor command. Skin/theme engine. Migration from OpenClaw. ACP adapter. No documented linting. No dev channels.
dimensions.openclaw_signals: npm install. Onboard wizard. Doctor. Dev channels (stable/beta/dev). Strict linting (Oxlint+Oxfmt). pnpm+Bun. Pre-commit hooks. Boundary AGENTS.md. Config drift detection.

dimensions.name: Testing & Quality
dimensions.hermes_signals: 400 test files. pytest. ~3000 tests claimed. No documented coverage threshold. No E2E test infrastructure. No drift detection.
dimensions.openclaw_signals: 3,534 test files. Vitest. 70% coverage threshold. E2E tests. SHA-256 drift detection. Performance guardrails. Documented test isolation. Multiple CI workflows.

dimensions.name: Native & Multi-Platform
dimensions.hermes_signals: CLI + gateway only. No native apps. Voice via TTS/STT tools. Nix flake. 6 terminal backends give some platform diversity.
dimensions.openclaw_signals: macOS app (583 Swift). iOS app. Android app (134 Kotlin). Swabble Swift lib. Live Canvas. Voice call plugin. Web chat. Broad native coverage.

dimensions.name: Community & Ecosystem
dimensions.hermes_signals: 202 contributors. agentskills.io open standard. Nous Research backing. MIT license. Discord community. 3,207 commits.
dimensions.openclaw_signals: 1,584 contributors. Corporate sponsors (OpenAI, GitHub, NVIDIA, Vercel). ClawHub marketplace. 26,602 commits. Calendar versioning. Extensive docs. Community plugins.
